item.title: 📣 Want to help shape the future of Arlington ISD? We’re inviting parents, guardians, empl…
item.description:
📣 Want to help shape the future of Arlington ISD? We’re inviting parents, guardians, employees, business leaders, and community members to apply to serve on one of our district committees. Your ideas, experiences, and expertise can help inform conversations and decisions that impact our schools and students.
Opportunities include: - Citizens Bond Oversight Committee, 2026 Bond - Community Ambassadors - District Level Instructional Decision-Making Committee - Instructional Calendar Committee - Long-Range Facilities Planning Committee - School Health Advisory Council - School Library Advisory Council - Technology Advisory Committee
There’s a seat at the table, and we’d love to hear your voice. Apply today! Read More Here: Help shape Arlington ISD https://bit.ly/4x5i8vF bit.ly/4x5i8vF
